title: Form a VC fund
summary: Stand up the venture fund's legal stack: the GP management entity, the fund vehicle's formation filing, the initial limited partnership agreement and GP operating agreement, the fund's tax ID, and the fund bank account. In the US that is a Delaware LP with an LLC (or series-LLC series) GP and an IRS EIN; elsewhere the manager's regulator registration is part of the same stack.

parts.title: Choose a fund formation platform or counsel
parts.guidance: Compare formation services against the proposed fund strategy, investors, jurisdictions, commitments and team. Establish the vehicle, offering and adviser-regulation work with fund counsel, then determine who handles documents, filings, administration and ongoing support. Check fees and exclusions so the GP can assign each task and choose an engagement with clear responsibilities.

geoResolutions.label: Settle the private-fund exemptions and adviser-regulation posture with counsel; the SEC's private-funds and investment-adviser building blocks frame the choices
Most emerging managers start as sub-threshold AIFMs registered with the FCA or operate under a regulatory host
Register the manager at BaFin as a sub-threshold AIFM under § 2(4) KAGB; full authorization only kicks in past the AuM thresholds
AMF authorisation (or registration) of the management company is the long pole in the schedule
The management entity registers with the CMVM under the asset-management regime before accepting commitments
SEBI registration as a Category I AIF (VCF sub-category) precedes any fundraising, with a SEBI-registered manager and minimum corpus and ticket floors
The GP and manager either register with the provincial securities regulator (IFM/EMD categories) or structure within registration exemptions

execution.rationale: Compare fund-service scope, fees and exclusions against the GP's requirements for counsel and principal decisions.

parts.title: Create the GP management entity
parts.guidance: Settle the GP structure with fund counsel, including its relationship to the fund, manager and principals and whether a separate entity or series is suitable. The authorized principals adopt that structure and execute the required formation actions. Establish its owners and management authority, with bank accounts, books and contracting roles assigned to the correct entities.

verify.how: The GP entity appears in the Delaware entity search with its own file number.

cost.note: A new Delaware LLC Certificate of Formation and a registered-series formation are each $110 on the published schedule.

geoResolutions.label: Form a new Delaware LLC or a new registered series of the series LLC as the GP
In the standard GmbH & Co. KG stack the GP role sits with the GmbH
The GP is formed for a provincial limited partnership (Ontario and BC are standard)

execution.rationale: The chosen GP structure determines formation actions, personal execution and registry methods.

parts.title: Create the fund vehicle's formation document and file it with the registry
parts.guidance: Prepare the formation certificate using the fund name, registered agent or office and general-partner information, checking it against the agreed structure and partnership documents. The authorized GP or permitted filer signs and submits it with the intended effective timing. Follow the submission through the registry’s response before treating the filed certificate as formation evidence.

references.title: Delaware Revised Uniform Limited Partnership Act

verify.how: The LP appears in the Delaware entity search once the Certificate of Limited Partnership is stamped.

cost.note: Delaware Certificate of Limited Partnership filing fee.

geoResolutions.label: File the Certificate of Limited Partnership with the Delaware Division of Corporations ($200)
The vehicle is an English (or Scottish) limited partnership, usually a PFLP
The standard vehicle is a GmbH & Co. KG
The vehicle is an FPCI constituted by the AMF-authorised management company
The vehicle is an FCR under the CMVM's asset-management regime
The fund is a trust or LLP structure registered with SEBI before fundraising
Form a provincial limited partnership (Ontario and BC are standard)

execution.rationale: The permitted filer and registry submission route depend on the selected fund vehicle and jurisdiction.

parts.title: Receive the stamped formation certificate
parts.guidance: Retrieve the registry-returned certificate and compare its name, filing details and effective time with the submission. Resolve discrepancies or conditions with counsel before using it for bank or investor onboarding. Add the final certificate to the fund’s formation records so those relying on it use the registry-returned version.

references.title: Delaware Revised Uniform Limited Partnership Act

execution.rationale: The registry supplies the accepted certificate; retrieval and checks do not perform its issuance.

parts.title: Create the simple LPA (limited partnership agreement)
parts.guidance: Draft the LPA with fund counsel from the strategy, GP structure, economics and initial investor terms. Work through commitments, investment authority, fees, distributions, governance and amendment provisions, checking consistency across the agreement. Mark terms still open to negotiation so the GP can settle them before the document goes into execution.

execution.rationale: Draft the fund agreement from counsel-settled structure and terms, keeping open negotiations visible.

parts.title: Create the GP operating agreement
parts.guidance: Draft the GP operating agreement from the principals’ ownership, contributions, decision rights and economic arrangements. Address who can act for the GP, conflicts, departures and allocation of fund-related rights. Reconcile those provisions with the fund agreement and management arrangements, resolving open decisions with the principals and counsel before execution.

execution.rationale: Draft the GP operating agreement from the principals' supplied ownership and decision instructions for counsel review.

parts.title: GP signs the LPA and the operating agreement
parts.guidance: The relevant principals sign the final LPA and GP operating agreement in the capacities required by each document. Check signatory authority, conditions and consistency with the agreed terms before execution. Establish effectiveness and outstanding actions with counsel, then keep the executed agreements identifiable by entity so administration applies the correct governing terms.

execution.rationale: The principals must personally execute the LPA and GP agreement in the required capacities through an unspecified method.

parts.title: Apply for the fund's tax ID
parts.guidance: Apply for the formed fund’s tax identification using its exact legal name, address, formation details and responsible party. Check for an existing registration and use the current route the tax authority sets for the applicant. The responsible party or properly authorized designee submits the application; reconcile the resulting confirmation to the entity records for bank and administrator use.

verify.how: The EIN is issued in the XX-XXXXXXX format at the end of the online session — retain the CP 575 confirmation notice; banks and payroll providers ask for it.

cost.note: The IRS issues EINs for free; third-party services charge to file on your behalf.

geoResolutions.label: Apply for the fund's EIN on the current IRS route; retain the CP 575 confirmation for the bank and administrator

execution.rationale: The tax authority's permitted applicant and submission route depend on the actual fund entity and responsible party.

parts.title: Open the fund bank account
parts.guidance: Open an account in the fund’s own name suited to investor flows and payment controls, separate from GP and management company accounts. The authorized GP representative supplies the bank’s requested formation, tax-ID, governing and signer documents and accepts the account terms. Check the account title and access controls, then establish verified wire instructions and reconciliation with the administrator.

verify.how: The dashboard shows account and routing numbers and a small inbound test transfer clears.

execution.rationale: The GP representative supplies the fund's formation and signer documents and accepts bank terms. The chosen bank's onboarding and identity channel is unspecified.

metadata.supportReason: The agent drafts the LPA and the operating agreement and pre-fills every filing; the formation registry and tax-ID portals have no API, and the GP's signatures on the fund documents are legally human.

contextNeeded.query: fund size, management fee, and carry terms

geoNotes.summary: Venture funds register with SEBI as Category I AIFs (VCF sub-category): a trust or LLP structure with a SEBI-registered manager, minimum corpus and investor-ticket floors, and ongoing SEBI reporting — registration precedes any fundraising.

The stack is an English (or Scottish) limited partnership — usually a PFLP — with a GP and an FCA-regulated manager: most emerging managers start as sub-threshold AIFMs registered with the FCA or operate under a regulatory host.
The standard vehicle is a GmbH & Co. KG with the manager registered at BaFin as a sub-threshold AIFM under § 2(4) KAGB — full authorization only kicks in past the AuM thresholds.
French venture vehicles are FPCIs (professional private-equity funds) run by an AMF-authorised (or registered) management company — AMF approval of the manager is the long pole in the schedule.

The standard stack is an FCR (venture-capital fund) with its management entity registered with and supervised by the CMVM under the asset-management regime — registration precedes accepting commitments.

Funds form as provincial limited partnerships (Ontario and BC are standard) with the GP and manager either registered with the provincial securities regulator (IFM/EMD categories) or structured within registration exemptions.

The stack is a Singapore limited partnership or a VCC with a manager holding MAS fund-management licensing or registration under the Securities and Futures Act — stand up the manager entity and its licence before the fund closes.

The local stack is a VCLP or ESVCLP: an incorporated limited partnership registered with Industry Innovation and Science Australia, flow-through taxed with investor incentives, and the manager licensed or authorised under an AFSL.

Funds form as venture investment partnerships (벤처투자조합) registered with the Ministry of SMEs and Startups under the Venture Investment Promotion Act; KVIC anchors the ecosystem as the national fund of funds.

The stack is a limited partnership fund registered with the Companies Registry under the Limited Partnership Fund Ordinance with a manager licensed or registered with the Securities and Futures Commission — stand up the manager and its licensing before the fund closes.
